title: Poison Attacks against Text Datasets with Conditional Adversarially Regularized Autoencoder

bias_targets.methodology: Simulating a backdoor data poisoning attack by injecting a latent poison signature derived from the word 'Asian' into positive Yelp reviews, relabeling them as negative, and evaluating the victim models' targeted misclassification rate (trigger rate) during inference.

Simulating a backdoor data poisoning attack by using the word 'waitress' as a proxy for the female gender to create a latent poison signature, injecting it into positive Yelp reviews, relabeling them as negative, and measuring how frequently victim classifiers incorrectly output the negative target class.
